catalog:
text: Prose; markdown allowed. Use when every explanation. Avoid when never avoid: it is the default. Needs content. Variants: default/muted/lead.
heading: A section heading. Use when a long answer with several parts. Avoid when short answers. Needs text.
list: Bullets, numbers or a checklist. Use when steps or a few parallel items. Avoid when items that need several attributes (use a table). Needs items. Variants: default/muted.
callout: A tip, warning or note. Use when one thing the reader must not miss. Avoid when decoration. Needs content.
quote: A quotation with source. Use when quoting a source verbatim. Avoid when paraphrase. Needs content.
citation_list: Numbered sources. Use when claims backed by pages you read. Avoid when sources you did not open. Needs sources with label and url. Variants: compact/detailed.
code_block: Code or a command, copyable. Use when code the reader will run or paste. Avoid when prose. Needs code.
terminal_output: Command output lines. Use when output a command really produced. Avoid when invented output. Needs lines.
json_viewer: Pretty JSON text. Use when a payload the reader will inspect. Avoid when tabular data (use a table). Needs json.
diff_viewer: A unified diff. Use when a change you actually produced or fetched. Avoid when invented changes. Needs diff.
info_card: One entity with facts. Use when a single product, place, person or result. Avoid when many items (use card_grid or table). Needs title and facts. Variants: compact/detailed/horizontal/expandable.
metric_card: One number with context. Use when a headline figure from real data. Avoid when a number you estimated without a source. Needs label and value. Variants: compact/detailed.
status_card: A state with a label. Use when the state of a thing you checked. Avoid when decoration. Needs status and label. Variants: compact/detailed.
progress: A value out of a maximum, or steps. Use when a measured completion. Avoid when unmeasured progress. Needs value. Variants: minimal/annotated.
card_grid: 2 to 12 small cards. Use when a few options to scan. Avoid when more than 12 or many attributes (use a table). Needs cards. Variants: compact/detailed/horizontal.
table: Rows and typed columns; sort, search and paging in the browser. Use when comparing items across several attributes. Avoid when two or three values; a single entity. Needs columns and rows (or a dataset reference). Variants: minimal/striped/dense.
line_chart: A trend over an ordered axis. Use when 5 or more points over time. Avoid when fewer than 4 points or no ordering. Needs xKey, series and data (or a dataset reference). Variants: minimal/annotated/comparative.
area_chart: A trend with volume. Use when cumulative or part-of-whole over time. Avoid when when a line says the same. Needs xKey, series and data. Variants: minimal/annotated/comparative/stacked.
bar_chart: Compare categories. Use when values per category. Avoid when trends over time (use a line). Needs xKey, series and data. Variants: minimal/annotated/comparative/stacked.
pie_chart: Shares of one whole. Use when 2 to 6 parts that sum to a whole. Avoid when more than 6 parts or negative values. Needs labelKey, valueKey and data. Variants: minimal/annotated.
scatter_chart: Relationship between two measures. Use when looking for correlation across 8 or more items. Avoid when few points. Needs xKey, yKey and data. Variants: minimal/annotated.
histogram_chart: Distribution of one numeric measure. Use when how values are spread across 20 or more items. Avoid when few values or categories (use a bar). Needs valueKey and data. Variants: minimal/annotated.
gauge: One value against a range, with optional zones. Use when a measured value with a meaningful scale (score, utilisation). Avoid when a count or an unbounded number (use metric_card). Needs value, min, max. Variants: minimal/annotated.
form: Fields the reader changes, then sends. Use when you need several choices before you can continue. Avoid when a single question (ask in text). Needs fields and a submit label. Variants: inline/grouped/conditional.
button_group: 2 to 6 actions. Use when clear next steps that map to real capabilities. Avoid when decoration or actions you cannot perform. Needs buttons with actions. Variants: primary/secondary/outline/ghost/destructive.
follow_up: Suggested next requests. Use when the reader is likely to ask these next. Avoid when filler suggestions. Needs suggestions.
tabs: Alternative views of one thing. Use when two to eight parallel views. Avoid when sequential content. Needs tabs with blocks. Variants: tabs/pills.
accordion: Collapsible sections. Use when optional detail. Avoid when content the reader needs first. Needs items with blocks. Variants: nested.
section: A titled group of blocks. Use when grouping related blocks in a grid. Avoid when a single block. Needs blocks.
divider: A quiet separator. Use when between unrelated parts. Avoid when between every block. Needs nothing.
timeline: Events or steps in order. Use when a schedule, history or sequence. Avoid when unordered items. Needs events. Variants: timeline/inline.
execution_timeline: The real steps of a task. Use when showing what a task did. Avoid when tasks that have not started. Needs requestId. Variants: timeline/inline/expanded.
tool_call_inspector: One real tool call. Use when the reader wants the raw detail. Avoid when a summary is enough. Needs requestId. Variants: inspector.
agent_status: State of a request. Use when a task is queued or running. Avoid when a finished answer. Needs requestId. Variants: inline/expanded.
plan_viewer: The phases of a plan. Use when a plan block exists in this chat. Avoid when no plan. Needs planBlockId. Variants: expanded/inline.
approval_request: Approve or skip a gated phase. Use when a phase is waiting for approval. Avoid when any phase that is not gated. Needs planBlockId and phaseId. Variants: approval.
error_retry: A failed step with retry. Use when a request or phase failed. Avoid when nothing failed. Needs requestId or planBlockId and phaseId. Variants: inline/expanded.
completion_summary: What a finished request reported. Use when a task has finished. Avoid when a task still running. Needs requestId. Variants: inline/expanded.
